title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow
seo_title: 8th Annual Gardens Aglow in Springfield, MO – Nov 28
description: The 8th Annual Gardens Aglow takes place on Saturday, November 28, 2026 at 5:00 PM. It is held outdoors at Mizumoto Japanese Stroll Garden, 2400 S Scenic in Springfield, MO. This event is open to a general audience.
